subject: english
stem:
The town closed one street to cars on Saturday afternoon. Families enjoyed walking there, while some drivers reported longer trips.
Which choice gives the central idea?
options: The car-free afternoon pleased walkers but inconvenienced some drivers
Cars should be banned from every street forever

optionRationales.reason: All drivers enjoyed shorter trips：與 some drivers reported longer trips 相反。
The car-free afternoon pleased walkers but inconvenienced some drivers：同時涵蓋兩群人的不同結果。
Families enjoyed walking：只說一方反應。
Cars should be banned from every street forever：原文只有 one street、Saturday afternoon。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「涵蓋全文但不加入未被原文支持的人、時間、因果或普遍結論」可推出 The car-free afternoon pleased walkers but inconvenienced some drivers；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The car-free afternoon pleased walkers but inconvenienced some drivers 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
